answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a bonded stake plus a distinct proof-of-personhood attestation recorded in a shared atlas of verified participants. To forge a duplicate identity, an attacker must replicate that attestation and post matching collateral, while a raven-style audit lottery randomly samples registrations for re-verification. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
